title: Gucci Intense Oud – Eau de Parfum for Unisex, 90 ml
short_description: An intense woody oud fragrance with saffron, rose and patchouli, for men and women.
description:
Gucci Intense Oud is an intense, woody Eau de Parfum for men and women. It opens with pear, raspberry and saffron, moves into Bulgarian rose and orange flower, and develops over time into a deep base of agarwood (oud) and patchouli. Long-lasting with moderate sillage.

**Size:** 90 ml

**Concentration:** Eau de Parfum

**Best for:** daily wear and office in autumn, winter and spring.

details.title: How to use
details.body: Spray on pulse points – wrists, neck and behind the ears – from about 15 cm away. Do not rub. Store away from sunlight and heat.

details.title: Shipping and returns
details.body: Express shipping across India. Easy replacement if the product arrives damaged or incorrect.
